papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 面向未来：离心抗阻训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心抗阻训练被认为是提高成年人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不清楚。目的 本系统综述旨在严格评估离心抗阻训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法 从电子搜索引擎检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原创期刊文章。

papers.title_en: Nutritional Strategies in the Rehabilitation of Musculoskeletal Injuries in Athletes: A Systematic Integrative Review
papers.title_zh: 运动员肌肉骨骼损伤康复中的营养策略：一项系统整合综述
papers.tldr_en: Based on the main findings of the selected studies, nutritional strategies that benefit the rehabilitation process in injured athletes include balanced energy intake, and a high-protein and carbohydrate-rich diet.
papers.abstract_en: It is estimated that three to five million sports injuries occur worldwide each year. The highest incidence is reported during competition periods with mainly affectation of the musculoskeletal tissue. For appropriate nutritional management and correct use of nutritional supplements, it is important to individualize based on clinical effects and know the adaptive response during the rehabilitation phase after a sports injury in athletes. Therefore, the aim of this PRISMA in Exercise, Rehabilitation, Sport Medicine and Sports Science PERSiST-based systematic integrative review was to perform an update on nutritional strategies during the rehabilitation phase of musculoskeletal injuries in elite athletes. papers.title_en: What Is "Zone 2 Training"?: Experts' Viewpoint on Definition, Training Methods, and Expected Adaptations.
papers.title_zh: “二区训练”是什么？专家关于其定义、训练方法和预期适应的观点
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.tldr_en: This commentary provides practical insight and unified criteria regarding the preferred intensity, duration, and session type for the optimization of zone 2 training based on the perspectives of acknowledged sport scientists and professional coaches.
papers.abstract_en:
BACKGROUND
The role of high-volume low-intensity training for enhancing endurance performance has gained growing interest in recent years. Specifically, so-called "zone 2 training" is currently receiving much attention, and many propose that this is the target intensity at which a large proportion of total endurance training should be performed. However, despite the popularity of this concept, there is no clear consensus among coaches, athletes, and scientists regarding the definition of zone 2 training.


PURPOSE
This commentary summarizes the perspectives, experience, and knowledge of an expert panel of 14 applied sport scientists and professional coaches with the aim of providing insight and a basis for definitional consensus on zone 2 training. papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：一项用于损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 运动科学中高质量案例研究的撰写
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes. papers.title_en: Impact of Neural network-quantified musical groove on cyclists’ joint coordination and muscle synergy: a repeated measures study
papers.title_zh: 神经网络量化音乐律动对自行车运动员关节协调和肌肉协同作用的影响：一项重复测量研究
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学1区/工程：生物医学2区/神经科学2区 TOP
papers.tldr_en: High-groove music promotes more coordinated movement patterns during cycling through two key mechanisms: optimized joint coordination, particularly in proximal–distal (hip-ankle) and axial (pelvis-torso) linkages, and reorganization of neuromuscular control strategies evidenced by increased synergy complexity and selective activation of postural stabilizers (SOL).
papers.abstract_en: While music is known to influence exercise performance through auditory-motor coupling, the biomechanical mechanisms by which musical groove—characterized by rhythmic drive and movement-inducing qualities—modulates cycling coordination remain poorly understood. This study investigates how groove levels systematically alter lower extremity kinematics and neuromuscular control during high-torque cycling. Twenty-four well-trained, right-handed cyclists completed high-torque cycling trials under three counterbalanced conditions: metronome (control), low-groove (LG), and high-groove (HG) music, with groove levels objectively classified by a validated deep learning model (R2 = 0.85).
